0748 'arak {aw-rak'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 162; v

AV - prolong 18, long 5, lengthen 3, draw out 3, defer 2,  tarried 1,
     ...lived + 03117 0310 2; 34

1) to be long, prolong
   1a) (Qal) to be long
   1b) (Hiphil)
       1b1) to prolong (days)
       1b2) to make long (tent cords)
       1b3) to grow long, continue long
